intended_behavior: The setup_llm method instantiates self.llm using create_llm(self.llm) and then checks if self.llm is an instance of either BaseLLM or LLM. If not, it raises a ValueError. This modification should allow self.llm to accept any subclass of BaseLLM (including LLM and any custom LLM classes), preserving existing functionality while supporting extended LLM implementations.
